title: The Lost Vikings
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 5747 (addresses via C2 ra_notes.py)
notes: Genre: Puzzle Platformer. Live values from RA notes, not checked in a running game unless said. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text: Erik the Swift (runs, jumps, headbutts walls), Baleog the Fierce (sword, bow), Olaf the Stout (shield: blocks, glides).
widgets.label: Three vikings

widgets.text: L/R switch viking, A/B their abilities.
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text: Each viking has 3 health points; food heals.
widgets.label: Health

widgets.text: Every viking must reach the exit. Olaf's shield blocks shots; Baleog's arrows hit switches.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: Spaceship, Prehistoric, Egypt, Factory, Wacky World.
widgets.label: Worlds

widgets.text: Each viking carries up to 4 items: keys, bombs, food, shields.
widgets.label: Items

widgets.text: Get the three vikings home from Tomator's ship.
widgets.label: Goal
